policy: Curated Emerald content through the first Gym. Each fact was checked by reading the cited reference page on the access date; no prose was copied and no bulk extraction was performed. Anything not confirmed on a cited page is omitted and listed under issues.

issues.description: Locations whose access depends on a sub-area, a tide, a random event or an event ticket are deliberately not gated: Route 111 (desert), the Safari Zone, Shoal Cave, Mirage Tower and Mirage Island, the Regi chambers, New Mauville, Cave of Origin, the Abandoned Ship, Altering Cave, the Battle Frontier and the event islands. They keep an explicit unknown.

issues.subject: fishing
issues.description: Old, Good and Super Rod acquisition is not reviewed, so every fishing encounter keeps an explicit unknown even in a reviewed location.
Party gender is recorded only for Roxanne's team, which was reviewed earlier. It is omitted for the rosters added later rather than transcribed without a second check.
Only the Rustboro City Poke Mart is curated; other shops are missing.

issues.subject: machines
issues.description: TM and HM rewards tied to a reviewed milestone are curated; the remaining TM ground locations and purchases are missing.
Move tutor locations and costs are not curated; the source only records tutor learnsets.

issues.subject: route-trainers
issues.description: Only Gym Leaders, the Elite Four and the Champion are curated. Rival, Wally, Team Magma and Team Aqua battles are milestones but have no reviewed roster.

issues.subject: emerald:phoebe
issues.description: Phoebe's first Dusclops also knows Curse. Curse was typeless before Generation V and the pinned source carries no Generation III values for it, so it cannot be recorded here. Three of its four moves are listed; the roster is incomplete rather than wrong.
